comparison.objective: Snap a lid fully around a filled hot-drink cup without tipping or crushing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Circular multi-sector snap engagement with distributed downward force and cup stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: All eight sectors are seated after release, with tight lid pose limits and no spill/tip/deformation gate.
comparison.reason: Both require multiple compliant engagements, but cup-lid seating is circumferential and deformable-contact sensitive; the candidate uses rigid rail geometry, paired spring prongs, telescoping, rack-unit leveling, and screws.
